assumptions.text: International buyers want authentic Egyptian pottery, textiles and jewelry with provenance.
Craftspeople will list inventory on a marketplace that handles cross-border payments.
Direct-shipping margins cover marketplace fees plus international parcel cost.
Repeat purchase rate from gift buyers sustains acquisition spend.
Quality inspection can be standardized across pottery, textiles and jewelry sellers.
Export paperwork for handicrafts clears without per-item licenses.
